description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pethiyagoda, Rideemaliyadda D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710012
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) in the Village of Pethiyagoda. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and cadastral mapping - all falling under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
